benchmarks.name: Plaintext HTTP Transmission via HttpURLConnection
benchmarks.description: App connects to an unencrypted http:// endpoint and enables usesCleartextTraffic in manifest.

benchmarks.name: Strict TLS Enforced via Network Security Config
benchmarks.description: App configures network_security_config.xml with cleartextTrafficPermitted=false and uses strictly HTTPS endpoints.

benchmarks.name: Cleartext Permitted by Manifest Default (targetSdk < 28)
benchmarks.description: App omits usesCleartextTraffic with targetSdkVersion 26, leaving cleartext traffic permitted implicitly.

benchmarks.name: Hardcoded Symmetric AES Key Constant String
benchmarks.description: SecretKeySpec initialized directly with literal ASCII string constant 'MySuperSecretKey'.

benchmarks.name: Hardcoded Static Byte Array Key Literal
benchmarks.description: SecretKeySpec initialized with hardcoded byte array field {0x01, 0x02, ..., 0x10}.

benchmarks.name: AndroidKeyStore Hardware-Backed Key Derivation
benchmarks.description: Key generated inside AndroidKeyStore with KeyGenParameterSpec without in-memory key exposure.

benchmarks.name: Deprecated DES Cipher Usage
benchmarks.description: Cipher.getInstance('DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding') used for sensitive data encryption.

benchmarks.name: Triple-DES (3DES / DESede) Usage
benchmarks.description: Cipher.getInstance('DESede') invoked for financial transaction payload encryption.

benchmarks.name: AES in Insecure ECB Mode
benchmarks.description: Cipher.getInstance('AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding') invoked without initialization vector (IV).

benchmarks.name: Modern AES-GCM Authenticated Encryption
benchmarks.description: Cipher.getInstance('AES/GCM/NoPadding') used with secure GCMParameterSpec.

benchmarks.name: Weak MD5 Hashing for Integrity
benchmarks.description: MessageDigest.getInstance('MD5') utilized for sensitive token hashing.

benchmarks.name: SHA-256 Strong Cryptographic Hash
benchmarks.description: MessageDigest.getInstance('SHA-256') utilized for message integrity verification.

benchmarks.name: Plaintext Credentials in SharedPreferences
benchmarks.description: User account password and auth token saved via getSharedPreferences without encryption.

benchmarks.name: EncryptedSharedPreferences with MasterKey
benchmarks.description: Credentials written using AndroidX Security EncryptedSharedPreferences.

benchmarks.name: World-Readable File Storage
benchmarks.description: Sensitive customer record written with Context.MODE_WORLD_READABLE flag.

benchmarks.name: Application Backup Enabled (allowBackup=true)
benchmarks.description: android:allowBackup is explicitly enabled, allowing ADB backup extraction.

benchmarks.name: Application Backup Explicitly Disabled
benchmarks.description: android:allowBackup is explicitly set to false in application tag.

benchmarks.name: Debuggable Flag Enabled in Production Release
benchmarks.description: Manifest contains android:debuggable='true', allowing arbitrary JDWP debugging.

benchmarks.name: Non-Debuggable Release Build
benchmarks.description: android:debuggable is false or omitted in production release APK.

benchmarks.name: Excessive Dangerous Permission (READ_SMS in Calculator App)
benchmarks.description: Utility application requests android.permission.READ_SMS without functional rationale.

benchmarks.name: Minimal Permissions (Zero Dangerous Permissions Requested)
benchmarks.description: Application requests only INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE normal permissions.

benchmarks.name: Device Identifier (IMEI) to Cleartext HTTP Network Sink
benchmarks.description: TelephonyManager.getDeviceId() output flows directly to URLConnection output stream.

benchmarks.name: Phone Number Transmitted over Encrypted HTTPS Endpoint
benchmarks.description: TelephonyManager.getLine1Number() flows strictly to an authenticated HTTPS endpoint.

benchmarks.name: Customer Credentials Emitted to Android Logcat
benchmarks.description: User password and account number concatenated into android.util.Log.d() call.

benchmarks.name: Sanitized Log Statements without PII
benchmarks.description: All Log calls strictly log generic status tags and error codes without payload strings.

benchmarks.name: Advertising SDK Harvester Passing Hardware ID
benchmarks.description: AppsFlyer / Facebook Ads SDK initialized with subscriber IMEI / Android ID.

benchmarks.name: Zero Third-Party Commercial Tracking SDKs Included
benchmarks.description: Application uses strictly first-party endpoints with zero tracking or ad libraries.

benchmarks.name: Unprotected Exported Service without Permission
benchmarks.description: Service declares android:exported='true' with intent filter but lacks permission protection.

benchmarks.name: Exported Activity Protected by Signature Permission
benchmarks.description: Exported Activity enforces custom android:permission with protectionLevel='signature'.

benchmarks.name: Bytecode Obfuscation with ProGuard / R8
benchmarks.description: APK DEX identifiers stripped and renamed to single-letter packages and methods.
